name: The Cardinal Park Case
source:
Although you're used to the chaos that comes with detective work, this case definitely takes the cake for, "The weirdest case I've ever worked on."

After one of your friends is brutally murdered, you task yourself with finding the perpetrator of such a heinous crime. Unfortunately, dealing with the fallout of her death and finding the perpetrator proves to be rather difficult for you, even though you SHOULD be a hardened detective by now.

[From [url=https://liminace.itch.io/the-cardinal-park-case-chapters-1-4]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尽管你已经习惯了侦探工作带来的混乱，但这个案件绝对称得上是“我处理过的最奇怪的案件”。

在你的一位朋友被残酷谋杀后，你的任务是找到犯下如此令人发指的罪行的凶手。不幸的是，处理她死亡的后果并找到肇事者对你来说相当困难，尽管你现在应该是一名坚定的侦探。

[来自[url=https://liminace.itch.io/the-cardinal-park-case-chapters-1-4]itch.io[/url]]
